gen-flavors-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Whimsical and a little bossy, Flavors towers up with diagonals as hefty as its stems, while BhuTuka Expanded One slows everything to a stroll.
gen-flavors-gf-hepta-slab: Flavors has a towering lowercase that looks like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, and it grabs attention fast. Hepta Slab answers in a stretched-out, bookish voice, with open counters and a lower lowercase.
gen-flavors-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads in a traditional, editorial way, with generous letterspace and terminals that stop well short of the stem. And Flavors, towering above it, keeps the page lively without crowding the text.
gen-flavors-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-stroke lowercase and whimsical diagonals. Padyakke Expanded One follows in a wide, literary voice, its glyphs spread like knots on a slack rope, so a lower lowercase gives the heading room.
gen-flavors-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads with each character floating apart from its neighbors, authoritative yet traditional. But Flavors stands far taller in the lowercase, and that height gap is the pair's real hook.
gen-freckle-face-fs-rowan: Rowan is a friendly, literary serif whose curves open generously and swell gently, set against Freckle Face's flat, fineliner-like line. Both are made for short stretches of reading.
gen-fredoka-gf-esteban: Fredoka draws a friendly, pen-like line that never swells or pinches. Esteban brings refined hairlines that stay sturdy beside its stems, though a small Fredoka heading would get lost beside such large lowercase.
gen-fredoka-gf-faustina: Faustina reads classic and authoritative, its bowls thinning gently and its c opening like pliers. But Fredoka's thick-only outline would feel timid if shrunk, and the lowercase height gap shows then.
gen-fredoka-gf-halant: Halant is authoritative and traditional, with a tall lowercase and a faint thick-thin shift in its serifs. Halant keeps a long page steady, while Fredoka's friendly single-width line stays softer and lower.
gen-fredoka-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Fredoka feels approachable, drawn with one nib throughout. Hedvig Letters Serif offers a taller, sturdier lowercase with open-ended curves and a quiet shift in line weight like brushed watercolor, which suits long reading.
